column1: Table 19 | Components of kidney health assessment for risk stratification in high-risk children during acute illness Component  Purpose    Serum creatinine  To assess kidney function and detect changes from baseline.    Urine output  To identify oliguria or anuria.    Urinalysis  To detect hematuria, proteinuria, or loss of concentrating ability    Electrolytes  To assess for hyperkalemia, hyponatremia, or metabolic acidosis    Fluid status assessment  To evaluate for signs of hypovolemia or fluid overload (e.g., edema,hypertension, respiratory distress), including weight changes, evaluationof fluid intake/output and assessment of capillary refill.    Medication review  To identify recent or ongoing exposures to potentially nephrotoxic agentsand medications that may require dose adjustment in the setting of AKI. AKI, acute kidney injury
